reviews.title: Size matters, oops!
reviews.comment: I am sure its a fine choice for someone who has the space in their case, but I did not. My Old GTX 1070 ti was only 10 1/2", this was around 12" with an extra inch from the jumbo heat sink at the end of the card. Did not work out for me. Thankfully returns were very straightforward and I got refunded within the week. Check your measurements thoroughly people!
reviews.author: Ryan
